name: Circuit Design Specialties Inc.
old_description: Best Circuit Design in the industry. Unparalleled craftsmanship & attention to detail.
about:
Circuit Design Specialties operates from Plano, Texas, as a woman-owned business founded by Randel Stewart, who serves as CEO. The company marks over three decades in the electronics industry, with Stewart bringing more than 33 years of experience to the operation.

The firm provides complete electronic and mechanical assembly services from its own manufacturing facility. Its capabilities span PCB layout—including high-layer-count, blind and buried vias, flex, rigid-flex, mixed-material, and high-speed impedance-controlled designs—PCB manufacturing, PCB assembly, cable and wiring harness assembly, and full box-build integration. An in-house engineering team handles new product development from concept through prototype to production, leveraging the manufacturing side to design for testability and cost reduction.

CDS serves industrial, medical, military, and government customers, ranging from small businesses to medium and large companies across the United States. The company highlights experience building cables and assemblies for industrial, military, and medical applications specifically.

The company emphasizes its differentiation as an electronic design service that owns its manufacturing facility, which it says yields significant cost savings over traditional contract engineering firms. It also guarantees fixed-price PCB layout quotes, uses accredited suppliers with verified component availability, and inspects every board before shipment.
